request.description: Debug session type. The Luma debugger only supports launching a program.

program.description: Path to the Luma program (.luma file) to debug.

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the program (available via Process.get_arguments()).

cwd.description: Working directory for the debugged program.

stopOnEntry.description: Pause on the first executable line.

noDebug.description: Run the program without stopping at breakpoints.

timeTravel.description: Record execution history to enable stepping backwards.
